episode_event_pm1002_00_00/6801_1001_200:
Once everyone understands how vengeful
and terrifying Chien-Pao and I are...
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/6801_1001_300: they will know who TRULY rules this land!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1101_100:
After procuring some cursed treasures, Lear
invited Raifort to come see them.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_200:
Wow. I never thought I’d see all four
of these treasures on Pasio.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_300:
I’m impressed you were able to gather them.
Being a royal must help.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_500: It’s generous of you to host a public exhibit.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_600:
So you’ve heard. Then allow me to cut to
the chase.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_700: I’d like to put you in charge of it.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_900:
Yes, you. I hear you know a lot about these
treasures and the legends surrounding them.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_100:
I don’t think I could find anyone better
equipped to handle them.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_110:
But first, I’d like you to tell me about the
legends passed down in Paldea.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4001_1001_120: Heh. Sure, I’ll hold a special lecture for you.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_100:
For generations in Paldea, an old fairy tale
has been passed down about four treasures:
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_200:
a vessel, a sword, a set of tablets, and a
set of beads.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_400: Their true forms, however, are Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_600:
As the four treasures were passed from
human hand to human hand, they became
tainted by hubris and greed.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_700:
Finally, when they came in contact with the
rapacity of a certain king, they awakened as
disasters and began to rampage.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_800:
After that, it’s said renowned Pokémon
wielders sealed them somewhere in Paldea.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_900:
I find it odd how easily you gathered these
cursed treasures here on Pasio.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_100: Do you mean they feel ominous?
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_110: You’d be right to think that.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_120: Team Plasma claims these treasures of ruin!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_130: Hey, you! How did you get in here?!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4002_1001_150: They’re even pushier than I am.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_100:
Lord Ghetsis, we have successfully acquired
the treasures.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_300:
We should thank Prince Lear for gathering
them all in one place for us.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_400: He’s helped me acquire more pawns!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_500:
These four Pokémon, the so-called treasures
of ruin...
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_600:
I’ll make them do my bidding, so that I may
rule Pasio once and for all!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_700:
The treasures of ruin have been put into
separate rooms, and we’re analyzing them
now. Soon, they will emerge—
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_900:
WHAT?! The treasures of ruin assumed their
Pokémon forms and escaped?!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_110: Hmph! I will not tolerate such incompetence!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_130:
If you have time to apologize, then get out
there and recapture them!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4003_1001_140:
Well, well... It seems one is willing to
become mine of its own accord.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_100:
I heard an unidentified Pokémon was going
around attacking sync pairs.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_400: You’ve fallen right into my trap.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_500:
I knew if I let a powerful Pokémon out to
roam, it would help me gather the strong.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_600: Ghetsis! Don’t tell me this Pokémon is yours?
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_700: It is. Meet my partner Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_800:
Why are you letting it attack other sync
pairs?!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_100: Chien-Pao holds many grudges...just as I do.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_110:
My noble plans were crushed time and time
again! Not only that—I was betrayed by
that INGRATE!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_120:
As a sync pair, we fester with hate and seek
vengeance!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_130:
You’re being selfish! You blame everyone
but yourself!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_140: Nemona! Quick, let’s calm that Pokémon!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_150: Yeah! We can’t let this slide!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_160:
I care not if you stand in my way. Do as
you please.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_190:
Even if we lose, Chien-Pao’s power will
only grow!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_200:
Its resentment from losing would become
everlasting hatred!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_210: Losing would also make MY hate run deep.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_220:
And thus, with my sync stone, Chien-Pao
will gain even more power!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_240: I am aware you are quite talented.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_250:
For long you have basked in the glory of
victory. You’ve never tasted bitter defeat.
It must be nice.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_260:
However! The more you win, the more losers
you create. Mark my words—they will all
come to resent you.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_300:
I mean... I know there are people who think
losing is no fun, but...
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_320:
At any rate, we were only here today for a
brief introduction.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_330:
I’m simply preparing my plan to rule all
of Pasio.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4004_1001_340:
Chien-Pao’s power is merely a tool I will
use to make the people of Pasio obey me!
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4005_1001_100:
Paldean treasures planned for an exhibit
were reported missing, allegedly stolen by
individuals with ties to Team Plasma.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4005_1001_200:
According to reports, the treasures became
Pokémon and are currently on the loose.
They were not seen with Trainers.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4005_1001_300:
The treasures are suspected to be hiding all
over Pasio. Their whereabouts are still
unknown.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4006_1001_100:
A search party is under way, and we are
seeking more leads and eyewitness reports.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4006_1001_300:
At this rate, people will start fighting over
that power.
episode_event_pm1002_00_00/4006_1001_400:
I must protect them, before they fall into the
hands of foolish humans.
